svg.title: CHL 711 before and after
svg.desc: Chlorophyll b 711 of the minimal example with its tail as tleap placed it (C8 R, C13 R, C2=C3 Z at 1 degree, C3 0.32 angstrom from CAA, a side-chain carbon of the same chlorophyll) and as v0.2.0 rebuilt it (C8 R, C13 R, C2=C3 E at 180 degrees, no clash).

g.aria-label: C3 sits 0.32 Å from CAA of the same chlorophyll
no clash with its own chlorophyll
